subject: Your Travel Booking Confirmation
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your upcoming travel booking for a 3-night stay at the Ocean View Resort. Your reservation includes a deluxe room with a sea view and complimentary breakfast. Please find attached your booking itinerary for reference. Kindly review the details and let us know if any changes are required. We look forward to welcoming you to our resort and ensuring you have a wonderful stay. Safe travels! Best regards, [Travel Agency]
